final: WITH matched_orders AS (SELECT DISTINCT o.orderspivot, o.ordertune FROM orders AS o JOIN orderexecutions AS e ON e.ordersmark = o.recordvault), type_counts AS (SELECT ordertune, COUNT(*) AS order_count FROM matched_orders GROUP BY ordertune), shares AS (SELECT order_count, 1.0 * order_count / SUM(order_count) OVER () AS share FROM type_counts), compared AS (SELECT order_count, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(order_count) AS total_orders, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
